edits.before: Zone with the arm — every minion they hide behind is tempo you taxed for free.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
